title.zh: 【币安攻击者已在 EVM 链上卖出超 130 种代币，获得约 2.79 亿美元】
title.en: 【币安攻击者已在 EVM 链上卖出超 130 种代币，获得约 2.79 亿美元】

current_state.zh: Lookonchain tracking shows the Binance attacker sold more than 130 different tokens across EVM chains, converting the proceeds into 123,400 ETH (~$277.3M) and 1.69M USDC, roughly $279M in total.
